title: Coils of a slinky
caption: The coils bunch into compressions and spread into rarefactions. Compressions 30 cm apart give λ = 0.3 m; 4 pass each second, so f = 4 Hz and v = fλ = 1.2 m s⁻¹.
alt: A row of coils along a line, bunched together every 0.30 metres (compressions) and spread out halfway between (rarefactions).
description: Coils bunch at compressions every 0.3 m; rarefactions lie halfway between.
λ = distance from one compression to the next = 0.3 m.
Each coil only moves back and forth along the line; the pattern travels.
